select
a.id, m.title, m .profile, a.createTime, IF(a.type = 'read', true, false) as readFlag
from oms_log_message_action a left join oms_log_message m on m.id = a.messageId
where a.userId = #{userId}
and a.type in ('read', 'unRead')
and a.type = 'read'
and a.type = 'unRead'
order by a.id desc
